content.text:
h03.

`internal/idp` (package `idp`, `internal/idp/idp.go`) defines the identity provider abstraction — the `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct used as the common user-info shape returned by any provider implementation.

`internal/idp/oauth2` (package `oauth2`, `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`) ships the concrete protocol implementation — an `IdentityProvider` struct that performs OAuth2 authorization-code token exchange (with PKCE support) and fetches/maps user info from a configurable `UserInfoUrl` using `storepb.OAuth2Config`.

Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`idp`); Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`oauth2`)

```go
// Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration.
package oauth2

type IdentityProvider struct {
	config *storepb.OAuth2Config
}

func NewIdentityProvider(config *storepb.OAuth2Config) (*IdentityProvider, error) { ... }

```
This is presently the only concrete protocol package under `internal/idp/`; there is no separate SAML/OIDC-specific package — generic OIDC/OAuth2 flows are handled through this OAuth2 implementation with a configurable field mapping (`storepb.OAuth2Config.FieldMapping`) for identifier/display name/email/avatar claims.
